title: Department of Energy: DOE FISMA Evaluation: Fiscal Year 2024
publisher: Department of Energy Office of Inspector General
summary: DOE OIG reported that 44 of 63 prior recommendations remained open and issued 79 new recommendations. Phase 56E entity use: DOE's later records show continuing FISMA and access-control work alongside a bounded 2026 statutory determination that the reviewed sharing requirements were implemented.
key_findings: The FY 2024 evaluation carried 123 recommendations requiring corrective action when prior and new items were combined.
